name: naranyala-pi-ext-prompt-clarity-with-multistep-form-or-options
description: is a powerful extension for the Pi coding agent that prevents "guessing" and reduces hallucinations by providing a structured, interactive framework for resolving ambiguity. Instead of the agent making assumptions about a vague request, it can now deploy a dynamic, multi-step questionnaire to gather the exact details.
